power.source: cmd battery get -f current_now (BatteryManager) x dumpsys battery voltage
power.reason: /sys/class/power_supply/battery/* returns Permission denied for the shell user on this build (Android 16 / OxygenOS 16); dumpsys powerstats lists no EnergyConsumers so no ODPM rails exist
power.equivalence: cmd battery current_now and the OEM dumpsys "Battery current" field returned byte-identical values across 90 samples; they are the same register surfaced twice
power.scale_evidence: as uA x uV idle = 0.0000004 W (absurd); as mA x mV idle = 0.406 W, inside the protocol 0.3-0.8 W sanity band
power.idle_stat: mean over all samples including zeros (per protocol mean-over-window)
power.noise_note: 19/88 idle samples read exactly 0 mA (SoC deep idle between ADB wakeups); under load the signal is stable so this affects only the baseline
power.idle_conditions: LOCATION 3: unplugged, screen off, airplane mode + WiFi (router 192.168.0.1), Doze disabled, ICMP keepalive active, no server running, battery 61%
power.idle_superseded: earlier baseline 0.433 W was measured with Doze ENABLED; runs execute with Doze disabled so the matching baseline is 0.5199 W
power.sentinel_note: with the keepalive active the 0 mA sentinels vanished entirely (0/105 vs 19/88 without); the device never enters the deep-idle state that produced them
power.voltage_dependence_note: idle current is stable across locations (114 mA here at 4.389 V vs 119 mA at 3.866 V previously) -- the 0.459 -> 0.500 W difference is mostly battery voltage, which rises with state of charge. Because power is computed per-sample from instantaneous voltage, run measurements track this correctly; but a single subtracted idle_power_w is only exact at the SoC where it was taken. Rows measured at low battery have a slightly overstated idle subtraction. raw_runs.jsonl stores every raw current and voltage sample so energy can be recomputed against an SoC-matched baseline.
power.cross_location_validation: idle CURRENT is stable across all three locations (119 / 114 / 118.7 mA) while idle POWER varies (0.4587 / 0.5002 / 0.4737 W) purely with battery voltage (3.866 / 4.389 / 3.991 V). The device draw did not change between rooms; the watt differences are state-of-charge artefacts. Per-row energy uses the baseline in force when that row was measured; raw_runs.jsonl retains every raw sample for recomputation.

case_state: bare (no case, no fan, no cooling pad)
